plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about statements from an online whistleblower who goes by the name Condor Man. According to those statements, there are five to seven places in the world's oceans where UAP, the government's term for UFOs, are seen going in and out of the water, and these are where NHI, meaning non-human intelligences, live and build their own craft. If true, it would mean something non-human has bases on Earth, under the sea.
